question: What should a small team record before comparing public AI answers over time?

observations.label: Demo A
observations.answer: Record an observation timestamp, the public surface, locale and visible source URLs. Keep a missing data rule beside the record.

observations.label: Demo B
observations.answer: A repeatable record needs an observation timestamp, public surface, question and visible source URLs. State a missing data rule before comparison.

observations.label: Demo C
observations.answer: Record the public surface, locale, question, observation timestamp and any missing data rule. Preserve visible source URLs when retention is allowed.

comparability_notes: The three surface, version and route labels are deliberately synthetic and different.
Source presence measures recurrence only; it does not rate source quality, support, authorship or independence.
This fixture validates the calculation workflow and is not an independent provider benchmark.
boundary: Synthetic owner-created inputs only. No provider output was collected, stored or published; no hidden queries, retrieval traces, ranking internals or model reasoning are represented.
